title: Talent Acquisition
overview: Talent acquisition today mirrors modern marketing practices. Acquisition teams must craft strategies that encompass building an attractive employer brand, facilitating smooth onboarding, and ensuring successful employee integration. This course aims to enhance the capacity of talent acquisition teams to effectively attract, assess, and integrate talent within the company culture. Participants will also learn how to align talent acquisition strategies with organizational goals and track progress and impact.
audience: This course is tailored for HR and talent acquisition professionals seeking innovative approaches to attract, assess, and onboard talent.
methodology: The course emphasizes reflection and encourages participants to recognize the evolving landscape of talent acquisition. It focuses on practical strategies, tools, and techniques to address current challenges and adopt modern approaches to talent acquisition.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the influence of global trends on talent acquisition strategies
Develop a compelling employer branding strategy to enhance talent attraction
Design an efficient and streamlined talent acquisition process
Customize talent assessment methods to align with job-specific requirements
Implement a comprehensive onboarding strategy for faster and more effective employee integration
Create talent acquisition strategies aligned with organizational goals and measure their impact
